notablePrerequisites: Axebane Guardian does not have summoning sickness. You control at least three creatures with defender.

description:
Activate Axebane Guardian by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color.
Activate Axebane Guardian by paying {3} and untapping it, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
